questions.question: Describe a project where you participated across the SDLC—from requirements and design reviews through testing, deployment, and go-live. How did you communicate testing risks and release readiness to both technical and business stakeholders?
You have led QA teams and conducted peer reviews. How would you provide technical direction and mentoring to engineers while establishing quality standards for an Oracle Cloud implementation?

Walk me through how you would test an Oracle Integration Cloud integration between Oracle Fusion Financials and another enterprise system. What functional, data-validation, error-handling, security, and regression scenarios would you cover?
Your CV notes experience writing SQL queries and PL/SQL programs. Describe a case where you used database validation to investigate a defect, identify its root cause, and confirm the final fix.

This role requires deployment and support of modules, upgrades, and bug fixes. Based on your experience with hot fixes, monthly releases, and production sign-off, what steps would you take to assess risk and approve a release?

Describe how you have used JIRA in Agile projects to manage user stories, test execution, defects, sprint progress, and defect triage. How did you handle a high-priority issue that threatened a sprint or release?
What approach would you take to validating Oracle BI Publisher or OTBI reports, including data accuracy, parameters, security/access controls, formatting, and reconciliation to source financial data?

Tell us about an example where requirements were incomplete or ambiguous. How did you uncover unstated requirements, document them, obtain stakeholder agreement, and translate them into test scenarios or acceptance criteria?

You have experience with Selenium, Java, TestNG, and page-object-model frameworks. How would you decide which Oracle Cloud business processes are suitable for automation versus manual testing, particularly when applications are frequently updated?

Describe a production issue or recurring defect you investigated using root-cause analysis. What evidence did you collect, how did you coordinate with developers and business teams, and what corrective or preventive actions resulted?
